question: What is the main job of healthy skin when it comes to protection?

options.D: Acting as a barrier against germs

explanation: You got this! Healthy skin acts like a natural shield, stopping harmful germs from entering the body. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h1)

question: Why do patients with skin problems easily get secondary bacterial infections?

options.A: They produce an excess amount of oils
options.B: Their immune systems are permanently shut down
options.D: Broken skin allows bacteria to enter deeper tissues

explanation: Spot on! When the skin has cracks or sores, the body loses its first line of defense, making it easy for bacteria to sneak in. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h1)

question: Which substance does the body overproduce during healing, leading to keloids?
explanation: Great job! Keloids form when the skin makes too much collagen while trying to repair itself. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h2)

question: A patient has a thick scar right across their elbow joint. What problem can this cause over time?

options.A: Reduced range of motion in the arm
options.C: Permanent hair loss on the forearm

explanation: Well done! Thick scars over joints act like tight rubber bands, making it hard to move that body part fully. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h2)

question: How can a simple skin infection turn into a body-wide emergency?

options.A: Surface bacteria travel straight to the bone marrow
options.B: The skin produces too much sweat
options.C: Pathogens and toxins enter the general bloodstream
options.D: Local inflammation causes instant kidney failure

explanation: Exactly! Once germs break past local tissues and get into the blood circulation, they can cause trouble all over the body. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h3)

question: A patient with a bad skin infection suddenly has a high fever, fast heart rate, and low blood pressure. What is happening?
explanation: Spot on! These are classic warning signs that an infection has spread into the bloodstream, leading to dangerous sepsis. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h3)

question: What common symptom of skin conditions often keeps patients awake at night?
explanation: You nailed it! Itching (pruritus) tends to act up at night, making it really hard for skin patients to get restful sleep. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h4)

question: Why should nurses care about the mental health of patients with visible skin problems?

options.A: Depression automatically cures the skin condition
options.B: Mental distress stops creams from absorbing
options.D: Emotional stress can worsen physical skin flare-ups

explanation: Great thinking! The mind and skin are closely linked, so stress and anxiety can actually make skin rashes worse. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h4)

question: Which part of the hand is best to use when checking a patient's skin temperature?
explanation: Correct! The skin on the back of our hands is thinner and much more sensitive to feeling temperature changes. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h5)

question: Which lab test does a nurse watch closely when checking for a worsening skin infection?
explanation: You got it! White blood cells are our immune system soldiers, so high numbers tell us the body is fighting an infection. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h5)

question: What is the main goal of putting emollients on dry, damaged skin?

options.A: To keep the skin hydrated and protect its barrier
options.B: To numb deep nerve endings and stop pain
options.C: To permanently kill all surface bacteria
options.D: To bleach dark scars back to normal tone

explanation: Spot on! Emollients soften and lock moisture into dry skin, helping the natural barrier heal and stop cracking. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h6)

question: Why must a patient finish all their antibiotics even if their skin looks completely better?

options.A: To kill all bacteria and prevent drug resistance
options.B: To stop topical creams from staining clothes
options.C: To guarantee that scar tissue never forms
options.D: To keep the skin from changing color

explanation: Brilliant! Stopping early leaves the toughest germs alive, which can cause the infection to return stronger than before. [learn more](GNS213_U5_T11#GNS213_U5_T11_h6)
